prompts.buildings:
Use-case: stylized-concept. Create a production game sprite atlas on a TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, 2048 x 1536 landscape, exactly FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows. Twelve isolated Christmas market assets, one centred in each cell, reading order. No text, labels, UI, grid lines, or cast shadows outside bases. Each sprite fully visible with generous transparent gutters. All objects same coherent highly polished hand-painted 3D mobile game style, rich timber grain, cream plaster, thick powder snow on roofs, evergreen garlands, red bows, amber fairy lights, inviting glowing windows. Winter evening warm light. Isometric camera from above, front and right faces visible; ground is a precise 2:1 diamond slab with straight edges, front corner at bottom centre; all use identical square footprints, ground diamond width ~400 pixels and depth ~200 pixels within their cell. Solid opaque art only inside the sprite, authored soft alpha around edges. Not a single scene: TWELVE SEPARATE CUTOUTS.
Row 1: (1) welcoming timber entrance arch with wreath and two stone pillars on snowy diamond plinth; (2) small open lumber workshop stall with logs, planks, sawbench, snow roof and garland; (3) gingerbread bakery chalet with pastry window, red striped awning and pretzel ornament, NO WORDS; (4) red-and-green hot cocoa kiosk with brass urn, cups, candy cane roof trim and steaming chimney.
Row 2: (5) toy maker's tall chalet workshop with nutcracker by door, toy train in window and dormer roof; (6) gift wrapping pavilion with parcels, ribbons, open counter and red fabric canopy under snow; (7) candle shop with many golden candles in windows, blue timber framing and festive wreath; (8) carved wood carousel with little reindeer, red roof with thick snow, tiny fairy lights, no people.
Row 3: (9) small open-air ice skating rink on a diamond snowy stone plinth, wooden rail and lanterns at corners, no people; (10) magnificent lit Christmas tree with golden star, red baubles, presents and low decorated fence, on diamond snow base; (11) two snow covered fir trees and glowing Victorian lamppost on one small diamond snow base; (12) festive wooden bench with red-bowed garland and a happy snowman on one small diamond snow base.
Each building occupies at most 82 percent of cell width. Do not crop the tree/star or chimney. Premium cozy Christmas diorama illustration.
prompts.icons:

Cozy Christmas style: polished hand painted 3D rendering, rich gold trim, warm highlights, crisp readable silhouette.
Cells in row-major order:
Row1: gold Christmas bell; red and white candy cane; emerald holly leaves with berries; blue snowflake ornament; purple Christmas bauble; golden gingerbread man; horizontal glowing golden shooting-star special on flat-top hex badge; diagonal down-right glowing star special on flat-top hex badge.
Row2: diagonal up-right glowing star special on flat-top hex badge; red festive firework bomb on flat-top hex badge; rainbow star prism on flat-top hex badge; thin snowy flat-top hexagonal frost floor tile (opaque pale blue snow); thin flat-top hex gold tinsel ring with open transparent centre; thick cracked blue ice flat-top hex ring with open transparent centre; thinner partly broken blue ice flat-top hex ring with open transparent centre; thin bright gold flat-top hex outline selection ring with transparent centre.

Row5: SAME star wand HOVER bright rim; SAME star wand DISABLED faded engraving; two vertical dark brown pause bars on round cream-and-gold medallion NORMAL; SAME pause SELECTED gold rim; SAME pause PRESSED recessed; SAME pause HOVER bright rim; SAME pause DISABLED faded engraving; small golden star completion medal.
Make all five button states distinct authored paintings within exactly the same dimensions and alignment, no labels. Every hexagon FLAT TOP with horizontal top and bottom and sharp side tips. No contact shadows beyond icon.
prompts.terrain: Use-case: stylized-concept. A portrait 2:3 game terrain painting, high resolution, a snowy Christmas market clearing seen from a high isometric aerial camera. NO UI, NO TEXT, NO CHARACTERS, NO CENTRAL BUILDINGS, NO CENTRAL TREE. This is the empty buildable ground under movable sprites. The middle 75% of width and 80% of height is generous smooth blue-white snow with very subtle pale cobblestones showing through, unobstructed and consistent at every point. Snow-covered fir forest and only a few distant cozy chalet roofs frame the extreme outer left/right/top edges, warmly glowing windows and sparse golden fairy lights along the forest edge. Cold blue winter twilight, warm amber accents at the perimeter, very subtle snow texture. The bottom edge is also mostly empty snow. Beautiful polished hand-painted 3D mobile game diorama terrain, readable surface, no horizon, orthographic aerial angle. The entire central rectangle is continuous walkable snow, not an island, no water, no separate platforms, no large rocks or props, no paths dividing into plots, no falling snow baked into foreground.
prompts.noelle: Use-case: stylized-concept. One isolated game character portrait on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background, waist-up, fully inside frame, cheerful young adult woman Christmas market organizer, short wavy chestnut hair, red knitted winter hat with white pompom, deep green wool coat, cream scarf, mittens holding a small wrapped red-and-gold gift at waist, welcoming smile, expressive brown eyes. Premium hand-painted 3D cozy mobile game character illustration, warm lantern lighting, softly stylized proportions, friendly natural face, sophisticated storybook winter atmosphere. Front three-quarter pose looking at viewer. No text, no backdrop, no UI, no extra characters. Portrait intended for dialogue at phone size, clear readable silhouette.
